headline: Drones hit two tankers off Romania; seven sailors missing
headline_es: Drones impactan dos petroleros frente a Rumania; siete marinos desaparecidos
caption_es: Dos petroleros fondeados cerca de la desembocadura del canal de Sulina, en Rumania, una ruta clave para las exportaciones ucranianas, se incendiaron tras ser atacados en el mar Negro. El presidente rumano, Nicusor Dan, afirmó que drones impactaron ambos barcos. Cinco personas fueron rescatadas del Wine Trader, con bandera de San Marino, y siete marinos siguen desaparecidos; el fuerte oleaje dificulta la búsqueda.
caption_en: Two tankers anchored near the mouth of Romania's Sulina canal, a key route for Ukrainian exports, caught fire after being struck in the Black Sea. Romanian President Nicusor Dan said drones hit both ships. Five people were rescued from the San Marino-flagged Wine Trader and seven sailors remain missing, with rough seas hampering the search.
summary_es: Dos petroleros fueron alcanzados por drones cerca del canal de Sulina. Siete marinos del Wine Trader siguen desaparecidos.
summary_en: Two tankers were hit by drones near Romania's Sulina canal. Seven sailors from the Wine Trader are still missing.
